name: Haus Pettneu
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Pettneu is located in the center of Pettneu am Arlberg in a quiet setting. The rooms are equipped with a balcony, satellite TV and Wi-Fi. The in-house restaurant serves regional specialties from Tirol. In the surrounding area, hiking trails and the ski areas on the Arlberg are a draw. The nearby ski bus takes guests to the lifts. The atmosphere in the house is family-friendly and down-to-earth. A sauna and a lobby area with a tiled stove round off the offering.
